result.title: Model-based neural network for global floodplains analysis
result.summary: We address the super-resolution of multispectral remote sensing imagery for long-term floodplain monitoring, enhancing Landsat acquisitions towards Sentinel-2 resolution. Exploiting the period during which both missions observed the same areas, we build DLhasa-L2S , to our knowledge the first paired dataset dedicated to multispectral super-resolution for river analysis. It covers the Lhasa River (Tibet), whose strong anthropogenic changes and diverse hydromorphological profiles make it an ideal study area. We developed two model-based neural networks: a forward-backward (FB) plug-and-play scheme and an unfolded FB scheme. We compared them against learned neural networks baselines (SwinIR, RDN) on synthetic data, on real scenes, and through a statistical test over the whole real paired Landsat-Sentinel dataset. The unfolded network achieves the highest PSNR and SSIM on the real RGB components with fast inference, offering the best trade-off between accuracy and computational cost. For NDWI-based water segmentation, its performance shows no statistically significant difference from that of the best methods.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向洪泛区长期监测，构建 Landsat 到 Sentinel-2 的多光谱超分辨配对数据集 DLhasa-L2S，并提出前向-后向即插即用与展开（unfolded）两种基于模型的网络，与 SwinIR、RDN 等基线比较超分与水体分割表现。
AI.relevance_reason: 主题为遥感多光谱图像超分辨率与水体监测，不涉及 VLM 内部状态、视觉证据筛选或 latent 推理过程；其中展开式迭代优化仅为图像重建算子，与 LVR 的状态生成和停止决策无具体联系，故排除。
